# Closure Report Review Policy
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Review rules protect human decisions without turning correctable quality issues into approval requests.

## Review Levels

| Level | Use when | Agent action |
|---|---|---|
| None | The stage can complete from confirmed evidence and stable rules | Continue and report the result |
| Review | A human choice changes the next action or unresolved facts need confirmation | Stop with a reviewable output and record the required response |
| Approval | A governance owner must accept, release, or sign the result | Do not claim acceptance without explicit evidence |

## Closure Report Rules

- Build may draft a report without claiming final business acceptance.
- Approval names alone are not approval evidence.
- Missing evidence or a required human decision before the quality gate blocks the run.
- After a quality pass, missing decision-maker response is `Governance pending`, not `Revision required`.
- Learn may recommend a next action. It must not claim human acceptance.
